_readme: EDIT ME before running run_audit_win.bat. Backslashes must be doubled. If you leave a path empty that case is reported as 'not configured', which is honest — do not point it at the macOS paths, they will not resolve here.
_out: leave empty to use the default (a results/ folder next to run_audit.js). Set an absolute path if you would rather it landed on your Desktop — remember doubled backslashes.
